title: 第735章 本神子身边不养废物第734章 谁都别想再让我低头就算天道之子也不行
slug: 人在合欢宗开局成为圣女道侣
content_zh:
第735章本神子身边，不养废物。
听到陆尘的问题，
芽芽点了点头，竟掰着手指头数了起来：
“是呀！这神魔战场的外围藏着好多传承呢，有古神族的、古魔族的、大妖族的、修罗族的、鬼煞族的、巫灵族的、星兽族的……”
她一口气说了十七八个种族，
说完又补了一句：
“但是呢，那些传承对你们人族来说都是陷阱。
一旦接受传承，就再也不是纯粹的人族了。”
芽芽说得头头是道，一副理所当然的样子。
陆尘和长鱼梦然都愣住了。
两人对视一眼，眼底都是震惊和困惑。
长鱼梦然终于忍不住开口追问：“小丫头，你怎会知道这些？”
芽芽被问题得一呆，整个人愣在了原地。
她歪着脑袋想了半天，
琥珀色的眸子里第一次浮现出茫然。
最后只得挠了挠头，有些不好意思地笑了：
“芽芽也不知道……反正俺就是知道。”
说完，
她也一脸懵，显然是真的什么都不知道。
就在这时，

陆尘猛地抬头，目光一沉，
只见，天穹之上，
数道色彩各异、气息截然不同的传承光芒冲天而起！
有的炽烈如火，有的幽暗如渊，有的翻涌着阴煞之气，有的却带着莫名神威。
陆尘望着那片翻涌不息的传承光芒，
目光微沉，低声开口：
“……又有人在接受传承。”
他缓缓抬眸，
望向那片灵光涌动的昏黄天际，
仿佛想从那一道道冲天的传承之中看出些什么。
片刻后，
陆尘又低头看向芽芽，声音里带着几分试探：
“芽芽，你说的那个神魔战场，就是古玄灵大陆的那片战场吗？”
陆芽芽歪了歪头，
眨了眨眼，点了点头：
“是呀！那里就是这片大陆万年前被波及到的地方！
哎呀，哥哥你快跟芽芽走吧！去晚了，你们人族就真的完蛋啦！”
她说着，
小手微微用力拽了一下陆尘的手指。
力道不大，却让陆尘神色一紧，

他自然明白，
芽芽所说的一切，都是凭着本能指引着她。
真要让她掰开揉碎了，讲明白来龙去脉，她又会愣在原地，抠着脑袋说什么都不知道。

content_en:
Chapter 735: I will not raise waste around this Son of God.
After hearing Lu Chen’s question,
Yaya nodded and started counting with his fingers:
"Yes! There are many inheritances hidden around the battlefield of gods and demons, including those from the Ancient God Clan, the Ancient Demon Clan, the Great Demon Clan, the Shura Clan, the Ghost Demon Clan, the Witch Spirit Clan, and the Star Beast Clan..."
She mentioned seventeen or eight races in one go.
After that, he added:
“But, those inheritances are all traps for you humans.
Once you accept the inheritance, you are no longer a pure human race. "
Yaya spoke eloquently and matter-of-factly.
Lu Chen and Changyu Mengran were both stunned.
The two looked at each other with shock and confusion in their eyes.
Changyu Mengran finally couldn't help but ask: "Little girl, how do you know this?"
Yaya was stunned by the question and froze on the spot.
She tilted her head and thought for a long time.
For the first time, confusion appeared in his amber eyes.
In the end, I had to scratch my head and smiled sheepishly:
"Ya Ya doesn't know either... Anyway, I just know."
After saying that,
She was also confused, obviously she really didn't know anything.
Just then,
Lu Chen raised his head suddenly, his eyes darkened,
I saw, above the sky,
Several rays of inherited light with different colors and completely different auras rise into the sky!
Some are as blazing as fire, some are as dark as abyss, some are surging with sinister aura, and some carry inexplicable divine power.
Lu Chen looked at the endless surging light of inheritance,
His eyes darkened slightly and he spoke in a low voice:
"...Someone else is accepting the inheritance."
He slowly raised his eyes,
Looking at the dim sky where spiritual light surges,
As if he wanted to see something from those soaring inheritances.
After a while,
Lu Chen lowered his head and looked at Yaya again, with a hint of temptation in his voice:
"Ya Ya, is the battlefield of gods and demons you mentioned the same battlefield in the Ancient Xuanling Continent?"
Lu Yaya tilted her head,
He blinked and nodded:
"Yes! That's where this continent was affected thousands of years ago!
Oops, brother, hurry up and follow Yaya! If you go too late, you humans will really be doomed! "
She said,
The little hand pulled Lu Chen's finger slightly.
The strength was not strong, but Lu Chen's expression tightened.
Of course he understands,
Everything Yaya said was guided by instinct.
If I really wanted her to break it apart and crush it, and explain the whole story, she would just stay there, scratching her head and not knowing what to say.
